question: Does top-8 posterior mass preservation retain near-Bayes causal shift detection under separately implemented fresh synthetic worlds and both 15% and 20% observation noise, without exceeding full Bayes's calibrated false alarm rate by more than 2.5 points?
source_isolation: Standalone newly authored JS simulator; no import of Gate19 source and no reuse of consumed seeds. Separate implementation by same research operator, NOT independent externally protected original-source reproduction.
world_contract: Five binary action inputs, 62 nonzero XOR mask+bias hypotheses. 24 OLD examples then fixed 16 NEW action-outcome pairs, first 12 distinct. SINGLE one mask bit toggle; DOUBLE swaps 1 active and 1 inactive mask bit; NONLINEAR adds a two-input AND interaction outside fitted XOR family. Independent hash/counter streams for old,new and deterministic action schedule. Source truth withheld.
prior: Old hypothesis uniform; P(change)=0.25; NEW conditional change hypotheses weighted by exp(-Hamming(mask)-bias_difference) per OLD, each normalized.

arms.top8: Top old posterior prefix until 95% mass or cap8; conditional NEW search <=2 mask bit flips (allow both biases).
arms.top1: Same prior/transition with old MAP only.
arms.full: Exact full OLD posterior over 62, all 61 alternate NEW hypotheses per OLD, conventional strong control.
arms.full_local: Exact 62 OLD, NEW alternatives <=2 mask bit flips.

calibration_rule: For each model and noise regime separately, sort 120 fresh NULL-only scores; threshold at one-based rank 119 = ceil(0.98*(121)); classify change only if P(change)>cutoff. Save all calibration scores and replay-free audit. No primary-informed threshold changes.

criteria.false_alarm: In BOTH noise regimes candidate NULL FPR <=0.05 and candidate FPR minus calibrated exact full Bayes FPR <=0.025.
criteria.familiar_recall: BOTH regimes candidate recall >=0.70 at noise .15 and >=0.55 at .20 and within 0.10 of calibrated full Bayes.
criteria.event_brier: BOTH regimes candidate Brier on familiar NULL+single+double <= full Bayes Brier+0.020.
criteria.ops: BOTH regimes counted full OLD fit+readout+NEW likelihood+transition operations / candidate >=1.5.
criteria.integrity: Every primary world 24 OLD and 16 NEW with first12 unique; same OLD/NEW for all arms, 100% OLD JSON posterior/readout parity. Raw calibration and primary actions archived.
criteria.nonlinear: Report NONLINEAR_AND detector performance descriptively; no bonus for a favorable out-of-family result.
criteria.classification: All required criteria pass in BOTH regimes => DEV_SIGNAL_UNQUALIFIED only; any miss => SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO. Never SCIENTIFIC_PASS or native checkpoint promotion.

plan: Commit prereg first. Freeze executable source second; read Git blob back before smoke or primary. One disjoint smoke, one 240-NULL calibration, one 480-world held primary. Save scores, world actions, and independent postscore arithmetic audit without replay. No new workflow/scheduler/runner/paid API or accepted model/owner/Amalgam/merge mutation.
